description: [TEMPORARILY PAUSED — use offline validate_manifest(id, content) instead] Scan a public origin across 37 protocol probe rules covering 30 agent-facing paths and headers (24h KV packet cache with 7d report fallback; pass fresh: true to re-probe live with a 5-min per-origin cooldown, rate-limited to 30/min). Returns { origin, checked, outcome, found_ids, found, absent, skipped, coverage, extracted, connect_recipe }; pass brief: true for found_ids + extracted endpoints only, compact: true to replace absent/skipped maps with absent_ids[], or verify: true to handshake MCP/A2A endpoints. Use probe for raw multi-path discovery; use has for one standard, or validate_manifest for A+–F conformance scoring.

brief.description: true: return only found_ids, non-empty coverage, and key extracted resources

compact.description: true: return absent_ids[] instead of full absent/skipped maps

fresh.description: true: bypass the 24h KV cache and re-probe live (5-minute per-origin cooldown)

id.description: optional single standard id or filename (e.g. ard, llms.txt) for a lean single-resource check

origin.description: public hostname to probe across all 37 protocol rules and HTTP headers (e.g. agenticweb.wiki)

verify.description: true: actively handshake declared MCP (POST initialize) and A2A endpoints to verify liveness

name: probe
title: Probe an origin
